summary: An excerpt from a fiction novel (Book 3, part 152) in which a narrator is drugged by a man who drew her blood under the pretense of a free medical screening, then uses the needle to sedate her. She has asked to see Sarah urgently and is told she will be taken to her after unpacking, but she loses consciousness in a tunnel-like haze, tries and fails to reach Sarah, and then experiences a dreamlike vision in which a huge butterfly-like figure, shifting into a jaguar mask, tells her she is special and that they will create life together.
one_line: A narrator is drugged under the guise of a medical blood test and slips into a hallucinatory vision while trying to reach Sarah.
key_facts: The narrator says the needle was not meant to take blood, realizing this only after it was plunged into her vein.
The man who drew the blood says it is a "free medical screening" and that he is running a batch of tests that afternoon.
The narrator asks to see Sarah, saying "I'm very worried about her," and wants to go as soon as possible.
The man says he will send Marcelina to take the narrator to Sarah once Marcelina has finished downstairs.
The narrator tries the door after feeling drowsy and finds it seems to be locked.
The narrator bangs her head against the door hoping the pain will bring her back to consciousness.
The narrator glimpses Sarah at the end of a tunnel wearing a white shift, but reaching for her touches only empty mist.
The dream vision takes place in a pastel-fogged room where a Melania butterfly the size of a man hovers above the narrator.
The butterfly's orange and black wings are described as pumping above her, with iridescent blues and purples shimmering off them.
In the dream, the butterfly's face evolves into the orange and black mask of a jaguar.
The voice tells the narrator, "Your body is a realm of fertility," and "You are one of the special ones. Together we will create life."
